en.text: Let God arise! his enemies be scattered! him also flee before him.

zhSimplified.text: 愿 神兴起，使他的仇敌四散，

zhTraditional.text: 願上帝興起，使他的仇敵四散，

en.text: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

zhSimplified.text: 他们被驱逐，如烟被吹散；

zhTraditional.text: 他們被驅逐，如煙被吹散；

en.text: But let the righteous be glad. them rejoice before God. them rejoice with gladness.

zhSimplified.text: 惟有义人必然欢喜，

zhTraditional.text: 惟有義人必然歡喜，

en.text: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! him who rides on the clouds: to the LORD, his name! Rejoice before him!

zhSimplified.text: 你们当向 神唱诗，歌颂他的名；

zhTraditional.text: 你們當向上帝唱詩，歌頌他的名；

en.text: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.

zhSimplified.text: 神在他的圣所作孤儿的父，

zhTraditional.text: 上帝在他的聖所作孤兒的父，

en.text: God sets the lonely in families. the prisoners with singing, the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.

zhSimplified.text: 神叫孤独的有家，

zhTraditional.text: 上帝叫孤獨的有家，

en.text: God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness...

zhSimplified.text: 神啊，你曾在你百姓前头出来，

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，你曾在你百姓前頭出來，

en.text: The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai— at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 那时，地见 神的面而震动，天也落雨； 见 神的面也震动。

zhTraditional.text: 那時，地見上帝的面而震動，天也落雨； 見上帝的面也震動。

en.text: You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance when it was weary.

zhSimplified.text: 神啊，你降下大雨； 疲乏的时候，你使他坚固。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，你降下大雨； 疲乏的時候，你使他堅固。

en.text: Your congregation lived therein. You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor.

zhSimplified.text: 你的会众住在其中；

zhTraditional.text: 你的會眾住在其中；

en.text: The Lord announced the word. The ones who proclaim it are a great company.

zhSimplified.text: 主发命令，

zhTraditional.text: 主發命令，

en.text: “Kings of armies flee! They flee!” who waits at home divides the plunder,

zhSimplified.text: 统兵的君王逃跑了，逃跑了；

zhTraditional.text: 統兵的君王逃跑了，逃跑了；

en.text: while you sleep among the camp fires, the wings of a dove sheathed with silver, with shining gold.

zhSimplified.text: 你们安卧在羊圈的时候，

zhTraditional.text: 你們安臥在羊圈的時候，

en.text: When the Almighty scattered kings in her, on Zalmon.

zhSimplified.text: 全能者在境内赶散列王的时候， 。

zhTraditional.text: 全能者在境內趕散列王的時候， 。

en.text: The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan are rugged.

zhSimplified.text: 是 神的山； 是多峰多岭的山。

zhTraditional.text: 是上帝的山； 是多峰多嶺的山。

en.text: Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? the LORD will dwell there forever.

footnotes.text: 68:16 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

zhSimplified.text: 你们多峰多岭的山哪，

zhTraditional.text: 你們多峰多嶺的山哪，

en.text: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands. The Lord is among them, from Sinai, into the sanctuary.

zhSimplified.text: 神的车辇累万盈千； 圣山一样。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝的車輦累萬盈千； 聖山一樣。

en.text: You have ascended on high. have led away captives. have received gifts among people, the rebellious also, that the LORDGod might dwell there.

zhSimplified.text: 你已经升上高天，掳掠仇敌；

zhTraditional.text: 你已經升上高天，擄掠仇敵；

en.text: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, the God who is our salvation.

zhSimplified.text: 天天背负我们重担的主，

zhTraditional.text: 天天背負我們重擔的主，

en.text: God is to us a God of deliverance. To GOD, the Lord, belongs escape from death.

footnotes.text: 68:20 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה*”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

zhSimplified.text: 神是为我们施行诸般救恩的 神；

zhTraditional.text: 上帝是為我們施行諸般救恩的上帝；

en.text: But God will strike through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness.

zhSimplified.text: 但 神要打破他仇敌的头，

zhTraditional.text: 但上帝要打破他仇敵的頭，

en.text: The Lord said, “I will bring you again from Bashan, I will bring you again from the depths of the sea,

zhSimplified.text: 主说：我要使众民从而归，

zhTraditional.text: 主說：我要使眾民從而歸，

en.text: that you may crush them, dipping your foot in blood, that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies.”

zhSimplified.text: 使你打碎仇敌，你的脚踹在血中，

zhTraditional.text: 使你打碎仇敵，你的腳踹在血中，

en.text: They have seen your processions, God, the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.

zhSimplified.text: 神啊，你是我的 神，我的王；

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，你是我的上帝，我的王；

en.text: The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, among the ladies playing with tambourines,

zhSimplified.text: 歌唱的行在前，作乐的随在后，

zhTraditional.text: 歌唱的行在前，作樂的隨在後，

en.text: “Bless God in the congregations, the Lord in the assembly of Israel!”

zhSimplified.text: 从源头而来的，

zhTraditional.text: 從源頭而來的，

en.text: There is little Benjamin, their ruler, the princes of Judah, their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.

zhSimplified.text: 在那里，有统管他们的小， 的首领和他们的群众， 的首领， 的首领。

zhTraditional.text: 在那裏，有統管他們的小， 的首領和他們的群眾， 的首領， 的首領。

en.text: Your God has commanded your strength. that which you have done for us.

zhSimplified.text: 的能力是 神所赐的；

zhTraditional.text: 的能力是上帝所賜的；

en.text: Because of your temple at Jerusalem, will bring presents to you.

zhSimplified.text: 因你的殿，

zhTraditional.text: 因你的殿，

en.text: Rebuke the wild animal of the reeds, the multitude of the bulls with the calves of the peoples. under foot the bars of silver. the nations who delight in war.

zhSimplified.text: 求你叱喝芦苇中的野兽和群公牛，

zhTraditional.text: 求你叱喝蘆葦中的野獸和群公牛，

en.text: Princes shall come out of Egypt. shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.

zhSimplified.text: 的公侯要出来朝见 神； 人要急忙举手。

zhTraditional.text: 的公侯要出來朝見上帝； 人要急忙舉手 。

en.text: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth! to the Lord—

zhSimplified.text: 世上的列国啊，你们要向 神歌唱；

zhTraditional.text: 世上的列國啊， 你們要向上帝歌唱；

en.text: to him who rides on the heaven of heavens, which are of old; behold, he utters his voice, a mighty voice.

zhSimplified.text: 歌颂那自古驾行在诸天以上的！

zhTraditional.text: 歌頌那自古駕行在諸天以上的！

en.text: Ascribe strength to God! His excellency is over Israel, his strength is in the skies.

zhSimplified.text: 你们要将能力归给 神。 之上；

zhTraditional.text: 你們要將能力歸給上帝。 之上；

en.text: You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. be to God!

zhSimplified.text: 神啊，你从圣所显为可畏； 的 神是那将力量权能赐给他百姓的。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，你從聖所顯為可畏； 的上帝是那將力量權能賜給他百姓的。
